# Side-by-Side Patch Bench, Not Clickable

This bench is a sign, not a button. You cannot sit on it, press it or patch anything through it. I built it to show a side-by-side patch, two versions of the same tiny sound stacked for comparison, and then forgot the one thing a bench needs: a way to reach it. So it stays a picture of a patch. The joke is that the most honest thing here is the thing you can only look at. If you want to hear the patch, ask me and I will describe it badly.
